content.en: The Global Tourism Plastics Initiative forms an essential ecological and environmental study area under Waste-Management in the UPSC Civil Services Examination.
content.hi: The Global Tourism Plastics Initiative forms an essential ecological and environmental study area under Waste-Management in the UPSC Civil Services Examination.

content.en:
• Ecological Importance: Key biological mechanisms, interactions, trophic roles, and biodiversity values.
• Statutory & International Frameworks: Pertinent provisions under the Wildlife (Protection) Act 1972, Environment (Protection) Act 1986, and international conventions.
• Threats & Mitigation: Anthropogenic pressures, climate change vulnerabilities, and sustainable management protocols.
